definitions.zero_shot_candidate_status: Whether any shortlist candidate passed the frozen zero-shot Stage-1 structured-output and safety hard gate (4/4 accepted transport records). Values: 'pending' (bake-off not complete), 'rejected' (no candidate passed; immutable once set), 'accepted' (a candidate passed; does not imply adaptation-base or official approval). A failed zero-shot result remains failed even if the same checkpoint later becomes a QLoRA development base.
definitions.adaptation_base_status: Whether an immutable base checkpoint is technically suitable for controlled QLoRA development under the frozen adaptation-base selection policy. Values: null (not yet assessed or selected), 'no_viable_adaptation_base' (hard requirements failed for all candidates), 'selected_for_qlora_development' (exact checkpoint chosen for development only). This is not an official safety or performance approval.
definitions.selected_base_model: Immutable checkpoint identity (repository@revision) of the unadapted base model chosen for QLoRA development, the direct-base baseline, and future adapter compatibility. Selecting a base does not approve an adapter or model strategy.
definitions.selected_adapter: Identity of a trained adapter (e.g. LoRA) approved for official use with the selected base model. Null until adapter training, evaluation, and formal selection in a later phase.
definitions.selected_model_strategy: Identifier of the frozen inference/decoding strategy (prompting, sampling, routing configuration) approved for official runs. Null until base, adapter, prompt, provider, and inference policy are frozen together at protocol freeze.
definitions.status: Overall contract lifecycle marker. 'no_selection' = every identity field null and zero-shot not yet decided; 'no_viable_base_candidate' = zero-shot bake-off completed with no Stage-1-passing candidate (legacy); 'adaptation_base_pending' = zero-shot rejected, adaptation-base selection not yet applied; 'development_base_selected' = adaptation-base chosen for QLoRA development only.
definitions.valid_for_official_use: True only once every required identity field for official model-backed systems is populated and formally frozen at protocol freeze. Always false while selection fields remain null or during development-only adaptation-base selection.

legacy_selected_model_field.note: The licence register's top-level 'selected_model' field predates this contract and must remain null. Use selected_identities_v1.json fields (selected_base_model, selected_adapter, selected_model_strategy) as the single source of truth.
